title: cheilanthes streetiae
intro: Cheilanthes streetiae, commonly known as the Mountain Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Pteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help in reducing inflammation and protecting the body from oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes streetiae include its ability to act as an anti-diarrheal, anti-spasmodic, and anti-ulcerogenic agent, providing relief from digestive issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cheilanthes streetiae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
